notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly digest of the best new games released on Steam over the past seven days, but which most probably flew under your radar.

This time: Pong with 500 balls, XCOM meets SUPERHOT, house-trashing wizards, the not quite so fantastical Mr Fox and feline Zelda.

notes.title: Evil Genome Latest Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are super excited about Evil Genome will be available tomorrow. Here are some bugs we repair:

Map keep locked after defeating Kobe.
Lachesis is stuck when she take an elevator.
Using sliding by crossing map cannot trigger deliver.
Joseph is not moving in story. 
Some interactions are hard to trigger in English version.
The main characters talks in the opposite directions.
Death will achieve the death of 10 achievements.
Unlimited access to Eye of Providence Equipment Archive 7.
The lethal trap did not die in Steel Fortress.
Punctuation shows wrong in menu.
Anti-ghosting
The monster model is stretched.
Enhanced cursor disappeared.
Mastery points show wrong.
After defeating Kobe, games doesn’t work.
The countdown disappears in challenge level.
Penetration has no effect on avatar.
UI bar display error when death.

notes.title: 《光明重影》更新公告
notes.notes:
大家好，《光明重影》明天即将发售了，在临近发售前我们再次对游戏进行了优化，希望能让各位有更好的体验。

以下为本次更新内容：
一、修复人形科比打通了，但是图鉴没有解锁的问题。

二、修复主角坐电梯无限鬼畜卡死的问题。

三、修复跨地图传送的附近用滑铲，导致无法触发传送的问题。

四、修复剧情中约瑟夫一动不动的问题。

五、修复英文版某些交互很难触发的问题。

六、修复剧情对话中主角方向反了的问题。

七、修复死亡一次后弹出死亡10次成就的问题。

八、修复无限获取书籍《全视之眼装备大观7》的问题。

九、修复钢铁堡垒致死陷阱没致死的问题。

十、修复界面中标点符号的问题。

十一、修复按键冲突的问题。

十二、修复怪物模型被拉伸的问题。

十三、修复强化光标消失的问题。

十四、修复专精点数显示不对的问题。

十五、修复打完科比后，镜头变化无法正常游戏的问题。

十六、修复挑战关卡的倒计时消失的问题。

十七、修复穿透弹对分身没有效果的问题。

十八、修复死亡时血条UI显示错误的问题。

璇渊科技
2017-8-7
